title: Emrys and the Homecoming
author: J. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Xanthe Hartwell, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must expose what the school board buried before graduation.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
